Northbank Community Garden — Important Notice

Please note that the north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm while we repair a leaking water pipe. During this time, please use the east entrance to enter and leave the garden. We apologise for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience while this essential repair is completed.

The seed swap has been moved to Sunday 19 April at 11 am. Please bring any seeds you would like to share or swap, and join us at the usual gathering area. If you have questions about the seed swap, please ask a committee member.

Volunteers are still needed for the repair and garden tasks. Please bring your own gloves; tools will be supplied. Mina is coordinating volunteers, so please check in with her when you arrive. Thank you to everyone who can help—your support keeps Northbank Community Garden thriving.

Quick heads-up, folks: the north gate will be shut this Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. We're fixing a leaking water pipe — not glamorous, but it's got to be done. Please use the east entrance instead. It's the one by the compost bays, and yes, the path is a bit muddy, so watch your step.

Because of that, the seed swap is moving to Sunday at 11 am. Same spot, same friendly chaos of envelopes and mystery beans. Bring your spare seeds if you have them; there's no pressure if you don't.

Volunteers: we'd love your help. Bring gloves — tools are supplied. Mina coordinates the volunteer crew, so check in with her when you arrive. She'll point you toward the right job and probably hand you a cup of tea at some point.

Thanks for rolling with the change. See you Sunday, or Saturday at the east gate. — Northbank Community Garden

Northbank Community Garden — Notice

The north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm. A leaking water pipe is being repaired. Please use the east entrance during those hours. If you normally reach your plot through the north gate, allow a little extra time and follow the east path instead. The north gate will reopen after 2 pm.

The seed swap will not take place on Saturday. It moves to Sunday 19 April at 11 am.

Volunteers helping with the repair should bring gloves. Tools are supplied, so you do not need to bring your own. Mina coordinates volunteers. Check in with Mina when you arrive so she can direct you to the work area. Please stay out of the closed north gate area while the repair is underway.

Questions about the seed swap or volunteer work can go to Mina. Thank you for your patience and help.
